THE IMPORTANT LITTLE DETAILS

Privacy & terms of use

We believe schoolwork should stay simple and personal.

Worksheet data

Worksheet content—including names and typed practice text—is processed locally in your browser. This website does not require accounts and does not transmit worksheet text to a PankhPages server. PDF generation happens on your device.

Site hosting and analytics

Your hosting provider may process essential connection data, such as IP addresses and request logs, to deliver website files. The supplied project does not embed advertising pixels, third-party analytics, trackers, or external API calls. If the site owner adds any of these, this notice must be updated before launch.

Educational use

Worksheets you create may be downloaded, printed and used for personal, home and classroom educational purposes. Do not present PankhPages branding or its source code as your own licensed product without permission. You are responsible for checking material and school requirements for your learners.

Availability

Features are offered as-is without a promise of uninterrupted availability. If the browser cannot download a PDF, try a current browser and use the Print option to save as PDF.
